description: List Latvia's public holidays in 2026 or 2027, sorted by date, each with its Latvian and English name. Use it when you need the dates themselves; for totals use latvia_calendar_statistics, and to turn holidays into long breaks use latvia_plan_time_off. year must be 2026 or 2027; any other year is an error. apply_transfers=true (2026 only) adds the moved days off, flagged is_moved_day. Set it only for staff of the state-funded institutions the transfers bind.

apply_transfers.description: apply the 2026 workday transfers (2026 only; they bind only specified state-funded institutions)

name: latvia_holidays
